name: just-build-it
description: 做就對了. Measure coupling, then grow flag-toggleable, independently deletable features until time is up. Leaves a CATALOG to swipe through.

interface.shortDescription: Never idle: hoard removable features for N hours, then swipe through the catalog.
interface.longDescription: Preflight measures project type and coupling to pick a mode (whole repo / one module / plugin-only) and freezes the core. The agent then loops: research competitor complaints, build one feature as its own directory + feature flag + tests + catalog card, pass three mechanical gates (core untouched, flag-off green, deletable), commit, repeat. The last 10% of time is forced packaging. You delete what you don't want the next morning.
defaultPrompt: Just build it for 8 hours, scope src/reports
